title: C4OS Grill Question 034 - Terminal Session Scope

questions.label: What cwd should a terminal use when no project is assigned?
questions.help: Recommended: user home directory. It gives unassigned chats a usable terminal without inventing a project boundary.
options: Disable terminal until a project is active

questions.label: How many user terminals should one chat session have in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: exactly one user terminal per chat session, matching the plugin instance rule.
options: Exactly one user terminal per chat session
Multiple user terminals per chat session
One terminal per project, shared across chats

questions.label: What happens to the terminal when its chat is removed?
questions.help: Recommended: terminate the terminal and delete its C4OS-owned terminal state because Remove Chat permanently removes chat-owned history.
options: Terminate terminal and delete chat-owned terminal state
Keep terminal running until app exit
Move terminal history to an audit/archive log
Prompt the user whether to keep it

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify shell selection, environment config, user terminal versus runtime tool terminal, PTY persistence, or read-only transcript behavior.
